d: Long, flowing jet-black hair with straight-cut bangs and two small braided locks tied with red ribbons frames a youthful, adolescent face with narrow, reddish-brown eyes. The build is slender, dressed in a white long-sleeved sailor-style blouse featuring a blue collar, a yellow neckerchief tied in a knot, and a short, charcoal-grey pleated skirt. Grey mechanical ship rigging with cannons is attached to the back and sides of the body.
